title: Issue-guided analogue for Read Input Registers
purpose: Recover the historically sensitive structure, state, or field interaction from the issue while replacing the concrete crash trigger with a safer valid analogue.
expected_behavior: Server responds with byte count 14 and the 7 register values.
constraints_preserved: Prefer Modbus/TCP ADUs with a 7-byte MBAP header.
Use protocol identifier 0x0000 and keep MBAP length consistent.
Diversify unit identifiers, read/write/diagnostic and file-record functions.
issue_safety_notes: Structural analogue avoids heap-based buffer overflow in read_registers() by using standard valid request; no exact historical crash payload copied; safer server response expected.
